title: Best Practices for Code Review
summary: SmartBear's vendor guide: review small chunks slowly and briefly, annotate and use checklists, never use review metrics for performance evaluation, and lightweight review matches formal inspection in a fraction of the time.

assertions.quote: beyond 400 LOC, the ability to find defects diminishes
performance starts dropping off after about 60 minutes

verdicts.note: Vigilance decrement is well established in general, but direct evidence for code review durations is thin and vendor-sourced.

assertions.quote: the author will often find additional errors before the peer review even begins
Checklists are the most effective way to eliminate frequently made errors and to combat the challenges of omission finding.

verdicts.note: Checklist-based reading experiments show modest gains over ad hoc reading; 'most effective' is overstated.

assertions.quote: If personal metrics become a basis for compensation or promotion, developers will become hostile toward the process

verdicts.note: Goodhart effects are well documented for productivity metrics generally; direct evidence for review metrics is anecdotal.

The report invokes Goodhart's law for productivity metrics like lines of code or story points, noting teams refuse to help others when it would hurt their velocity; the gaming mechanism applies, but code review metrics are not studied.

assertions.quote: The knowledge that others will be examining their work naturally drives people to produce a better product.

verdicts.note: Accountability effects are plausible and reported by practitioners, but the spot-check figures come from one vendor study.
A manager describes the 'discipline of explaining your code to your peers' as driving a higher standard of coding; an opinion from a survey, and the effect on unreviewed changes is not examined.

assertions.quote: lightweight code review takes less than 20% the time of formal reviews and finds just as many bugs!

verdicts.note: Vendor data; independent studies (Bacchelli and Bird) find modern lightweight review catches fewer defects than expected, with most value in knowledge transfer.

assertions.quote: Peer review also allows junior team members to learn from senior leaders and for even the most experienced programmers to break bad habits.
